observations.observed: The preview remained on desktop-ch-new-visit after Periksa registrasi, although every branch of that action navigates to another frame.
observations.inference: A native pointer event may have been missed; no validation rejection was observed.
observations.change: Allow one bounded pointer retry only while the preview remains at the source. A wrong destination still fails.

limits: These observations concern the native FigCraft test driver, not a production browser or backend.
Pointer retry and scroll readiness do not establish the internal cause of the earlier failures.
